description:
Recorded in Batubulan, Gianyar, Bali, Indonesia, during August/December 2020.

I composed this instrumental album named "Kuningan" in a very small room, in a family house, surrounded by kids, small houses and the view of the mountains.

"Kuningan" is the name of a Balinese Hindu celebration, where a lot of offerings are given and prayers are spoken for welcoming back spirits of dead family members who are willing to return home. 

Wishing you enjoy this instrumental beats,
Gracias, thankyou, terima kasih.
